divergenceIssues: No actual native RoomPlan companion capture/upload flow is implemented; the iOS package only provides envelope types, URL helpers, and JSON encoding.
No actual `POST /captures/roomplan` HTTP endpoint is implemented.
`SceneHead`/`SceneSnapshot` are not durably persisted; ingest only stores scenes in in-memory `Map`s and does not write to the defined database schema.
